# Allong: Walking Buddy

> Allong (Korean App Store name: 알롱) is a free iPhone step counter and walking game. You hatch a small creature from an egg and walk together. Turn walks into adventures. Coming soon to the App Store.

## Facts
- Platform: iOS (iPhone). Free to play, no in-app purchases.
- Genre and search terms: walking game, step counter (pedometer), pixel RPG, creature raising like a virtual pet (Korean: 키우기, 육성), egg hatching, map exploration.
- Age: ages 14 and up; the app checks your age when you first open it.
- Steps are counted from the distance you actually move.
- Explore: walk a real map, pick up materials, and meet all kinds of Dallongs along the way, and battle them.
- Craft and outfits: make outfits and tools from materials.
- Widgets: Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets and a Live Activity while exploring.
- Accounts: you start as a guest; linking an Apple or Google account restores your Allong on a new device.
- Data: no ads, no tracking; location stays on the device. See the Privacy Policy below.
- Coming soon (no order or dates, plans may change): friends, raids, crews, an exchange.
- Languages: 14, including English and Korean.
